page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u1-c1m2.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon processor running at 2.5 GHz. Managed via the KVM hypervisor, this instance features 32 dedicated virtual CPUs mapped from 16 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. It is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB per vCPU. The processor includes a 33 MB L3 cache and supports instruction set extensions such as AVX, AVX512F, and AES. This instance does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying entirely on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals a clear performance tradeoff between single-core and multi-core operations. Single-core performance is relatively weak, as shown by stress-ng single-core and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the bottom 25% tier. Single-threaded gzip compression also reflects this limitation. Conversely, multi-core and parallelized execution metrics, including stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, consistently register in the average tier. Memory bandwidth tests, such as uncached large-block reads at 109.41 GB/sec and writes at 48.07 GB/sec, also align with mid-range performance expectations.

Given the 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and dedicated CPU allocation, this instance is structured for compute-focused workloads that can leverage parallel execution to overcome modest single-core speeds. It is suitable for multi-threaded tasks such as software compilation, text and image processing, and moderate database operations, as demonstrated by its average Passmark database and Redis SET performance. The lack of local storage and GPU acceleration makes it less suitable for heavy storage-bound databases or large-scale deep learning, though it supports small to medium LLM inference. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the instance offers a balanced mid-tier hardware profile for parallelized compute tasks without the premium cost of high-RAM or GPU-enabled configurations.
